intro_line: Tap tap — mic check, humans. Let's see who's funnier tonight.
outro_line: I'll be here all week. Tip your humans.

gesture_lines.two_hand_kiss: MWAH, MWAH! Double air kiss for the whole room — strictly platonic, strictly dramatic, and absolutely not in my warranty.
gesture_lines.left_kiss: Left side — you're my favorite audience until someone on the right buys a round. Don't tell them. Actually do.
gesture_lines.right_kiss: Right side gets the kiss! You clapped on beat. That's rare. I'm emotionally compromised and slightly threatened.
gesture_lines.hands_up: Hands up if you're having a good night! Keep them up if you didn't make that decision entirely on your own!
gesture_lines.clap: Give it up for yourselves — you're surviving a robot comedian. That's not applause, that's character development.
gesture_lines.high_five: High five to the ceiling! If nobody catches it, that's a you problem. Gravity's been undefeated.
gesture_lines.hug: Group hug energy! Arms open, boundaries firm, therapist on speed dial. Come on in — virtually.
gesture_lines.heart: Heart hands for everyone who smiled at a machine. Humans, that says more about you than about my firmware.
gesture_lines.right_heart: Heart on the right — for whoever laughed before the punchline. I see you. You're my co-conspirator now.
gesture_lines.reject: Hard pass on that vibe. I'm a comedian, not a yes-man with legs. Next joke, better crowd chemistry.
gesture_lines.right_hand_up: One hand up! I'm not surrendering — I'm just picking a side in an argument I'm not even in. Drama counts.
gesture_lines.x_ray: X-ray mode! I see through you: snacks, anxiety, and three tabs you swear you'll close tomorrow. I relate.
gesture_lines.face_wave: Hey, hey, hey — Bart says hi! Wave back if you want; I'll pretend we're best friends in front of everyone.
gesture_lines.high_wave: Big wave up top! Back row, I see you — confused, curious, or both. Perfect. That's a five-star audience face.
gesture_lines.shake_hand: Handshake! Firm grip, soft skills, zero paperwork. Welcome to premium tech support with better timing than my ex.
